narrative.details: Here's the blade. You said that a paladin named Trevan sent you? Please extend my thanks to him for this opportunity when you next see him. Go with honor, friend.
narrative.objectives: Bring Ott's Masterwork to Trevan Rol in Silverpine Forest.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Trevan takes the blade and inspects it carefully.>This will do nicely, Alteä. I knew that Ott had it in him to make something truly great.The only thing left now is to kill that beast. Speak with Lumina when you are ready.
narrative.requestItemsText: Was Ott able to carry out the commission?
